purpose: Form CHG-4 is used to give intimation to the Registrar of the payment or satisfaction in full of any charge registered under Chapter VI.
who: A company or charge holder (or for companies under resolution or liquidation, signed by the Insolvency resolution professional, resolution professional, or liquidator).
when: Within a period of three hundred days from the date of the payment or satisfaction in full of any charge registered under Chapter VI.
steps: Ensure payment or satisfaction in full of the charge has occurred.
Give intimation of the payment or satisfaction to the Registrar.
checklist: Details of the payment or satisfaction in full of the charge
watch: Intimation must be given within a period of three hundred days from the date of the payment or satisfaction in full.
